newsitem.title: UK: UK must stick with inflation targets - BoE's King.
newsitem.headline: UK must stick with inflation targets - BoE's King.

text.p: Britain has yet to achieve price stability in combination with economic growth but can do so if it sticks to a consistent inflation target, Bank of England chief economist Mervyn King said on Thursday.

"Both theory and history suggest that it (price stability) is within our grasp provided that we continue to pursue consistently a suitable inflation target," King said in a speech to the Economic and Social Research Council in London.
"On monetary stability, the test is not whether inflation is below a certain number on a particular date," King said.
"It is whether the regime of monetary policy leads to the widespread expectation that inflation will not be a relevant factor in economic decisions in the future."

He said that a modern central bank must be open in its actions and motives. "If it wishes to be judged on a fair and honest basis, it must forsake mystique and mumbo jumbo for transparency and openness."
